direct_official_checks: OSGM15 transforms ETRS89 ellipsoid height to orthometric height
on mainland Britain OSGM15 gives ODN heights
OSGM15 is based on a gravimetric geoid model
values are obtained by bilinear interpolation
nominal mainland UK accuracy is 8mm rms
accuracy is better than 2cm rms for other covered areas
OS recommends OSGM15 with OS Net for high-accuracy orthometric heighting
quality_effect: Separates vertical datum transformation uncertainty from terrain-model uncertainty.
